title: Derived internal Hom from a bounded-above finite-free model
statement: Let $(U,\mathcal O_U)$ be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], let $E^\bullet$ be a bounded-above cochain complex of finite-rank free $\mathcal O_U$-modules, and let $\mathcal G^\bullet$ be a bounded-below cochain complex of $\mathcal O_U$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. If $E^\bullet\to\mathcal K^\bullet$ is a quasi-isomorphism, then the total sheaf Hom complex $\mathcal H om^\bullet_{\mathcal O_U}(E^\bullet,\mathcal G^\bullet)$ represents $R\mathcal H om_{\mathcal O_U}(\mathcal K^\bullet,\mathcal G^\bullet)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom].
